profile.headline: Software Engineer at Sharecare
profile.summary:
I build enterprise software at scale and use AI not just as a tool — but as infrastructure. My focus is designing the systems, workflows, and tooling that make AI genuinely productive across engineering organizations.

What I'm working on:
- Building enterprise AI steering systems that inject infrastructure context, auth patterns, and security guidelines into AI coding sessions — measurably improving output quality across teams
- Developing MCP servers and AI agents that give engineers and AI tools real-time access to production logs, test data generation, and internal tooling
- Delivering full production applications via spec engineering and AI-assisted development (Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, Spring Boot 3.x)
- Managing large-scale systems handling millions of sensitive healthcare records with strict HIPAA and security compliance requirements

Recent highlights:
- Establish enterprise-wide AI tooling strategy and standardize how our engineering team interacts with AI
- Delivered a fully branded white-label mobile health app end-to-end using Kiro and spec engineering
- Built AI regression harness infrastructure that unblocked security updates across dozens of unmaintained microservices

I care about AI that actually ships — scalable, secure, and grounded in real engineering discipline.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architect and optimize multiple Spring Boot 3.x microservices handling millions of records in high-volume production environments, ensuring scalability and performance for healthcare eligibility systems
- Pioneer AI-assisted development practices using Cursor, Claude Code, and Amazon Q to accelerate feature delivery while maintaining code quality across enterprise-scale codebases
- Implement Apache Airflow data pipeline for automated data lifecycle management, processing millions of records and saving thousands in monthly storage costs
- Monitor and optimize microservice performance using Grafana, proactively analyzing metrics and logs to identify bottlenecks and improve system efficiency
- Develop and maintain secure, HIPAA-compliant applications handling PII/PHI data with zero trust security principles
- Lead development of multi-payer healthcare benefits platform serving large group employees navigating complex benefits landscapes
- Build event-driven, real-time software using React, Node.js, Next.js, and Java for member-facing applications
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · REST APIs · Spring Boot · User Experience (UX) · Node.js

positions.title: CTO and Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Building custom Lightning Web Components and Apex services for enhanced user experiences for the Salesforce Lightning platform
- Brainstorming innovative ideas to extend the Salesforce platform to meet the needs of users
- Writing scalable & maintainable code with a fully automated test suite to drastically reduce defects and increase product quality & stability.
positions.insights: Skills: Lightning Web Components · JavaScript · Apex Programming · Salesforce · User Experience (UX)
